title: TodayWeather for iOS: native app user manual
scenario: Version 2.0.0 preview on an iPhone 16 simulator, Korean screens; English instructions keep the Korean control labels. Live examples captured on 17 November 2026 (Korea time); weather, ads and iOS dialogs vary.

steps.title: Read the first-launch notice
steps.instruction: Open TodayWeather and read 선택 접근 권한 (Optional permissions). Tap 확인 (OK). The notice keeps the Cordova app's wording; this app asks iOS for location only when you choose the current location.
steps.caption: The access notice appears over the start page on every visit to the start page.
steps.expected: The notice closes; the start page remains.

steps.title: Choose how to start
steps.instruction: Search for a place in the field, tap a city shortcut, or tap 현재위치 날씨보기 (Weather at my location).
steps.caption: The start page shows the search field, city shortcuts and the current-location button.
steps.expected: Your choice adds the first place and opens hourly weather.

steps.title: See weather at your location
steps.instruction: Tap 현재위치 날씨보기. If iOS asks, allow location while using the app. The title shows the place found and the location glyph.
steps.caption: Hourly weather for the current position (명동 here, from the simulated position at Seoul City Hall).
steps.expected: The current place opens on the Hourly tab (시간별날씨).

steps.title: Scroll the hourly page
steps.instruction: Scroll down on 시간별날씨 to read the hourly air forecast (시간별대기예보) and the detail rows (상세날씨) under the chart.
steps.caption: Under the chart: hourly air quality and the detailed weather of the hour.
steps.expected: The header and tab bar stay in place while the page scrolls.

steps.title: Expand the chart details
steps.instruction: Tap the small arrow row under the hourly chart. Tap it again to fold the rows.
steps.caption: The chart grows: wind and humidity rows appear under it (scroll down to read them all).
steps.expected: The detail rows stay open until you fold them.

steps.title: Look at earlier hours
steps.instruction: Swipe right on the hourly chart.
steps.caption: The chart scrolls to earlier hours.
steps.expected: Only the chart scrolls; the place stays the same.

steps.title: Look at later hours
steps.instruction: Swipe left on the hourly chart.
steps.caption: The chart scrolls to later hours.
steps.expected: Only the chart scrolls; the place stays the same.

steps.title: Read daily weather
steps.instruction: Tap 일별날씨 (Daily) in the tab bar.
steps.caption: Daily weather: sky, rain and the day's highest and lowest temperatures.
steps.expected: The daily chart opens around today.

steps.title: Look at earlier days
steps.instruction: Swipe right on the daily chart.
steps.caption: The chart shows past days.
steps.expected: Only the chart scrolls.

steps.title: Look at later days
steps.instruction: Swipe left on the daily chart.
steps.caption: The chart shows the coming days.
steps.expected: Only the chart scrolls.

steps.title: Read the air-quality summary
steps.instruction: Tap 대기정보 (Air) in the tab bar.
steps.caption: The overall air index with its grade, advice and scale, then the hourly air chart.
steps.expected: The air page shows the selected place.

steps.title: Choose a pollutant
steps.instruction: Scroll to 상세대기정보 (Air details) and tap a pollutant, here 초미세먼지 (PM2.5).
steps.caption: The top of the page shows the chosen pollutant. A dash means the station sent no value.
steps.expected: The page returns to its top with that pollutant.

steps.title: Find the monitoring stations
steps.instruction: Scroll down to 측정소 (Stations): the publication time, the standard and the stations near the place.
steps.caption: The nearby stations of the chosen pollutant.
steps.expected: The first station is selected.

steps.title: Change the monitoring station
steps.instruction: Tap another station, here 청계천.
steps.caption: The top of the page shows that station's value.
steps.expected: The page returns to its top with the station's value.

steps.title: Open your saved places
steps.instruction: Tap 즐겨찾기 (Locations) in the tab bar.
steps.caption: Saved places with their sky, temperature and today's range; the bell shows whether alarms are set.
steps.expected: Tapping a row opens its weather.

steps.title: Search for a place
steps.instruction: Tap the search field, type a name (부산) and close the keyboard with Done.
steps.caption: Matching places appear under 현재위치로 지역찾기 (Find by location): the app's list of Korean towns first, Google's suggestions further down.
steps.expected: Tapping a result adds it.

steps.title: See the new place
steps.instruction: Tap a result, here Google's suggestion 대한민국 부산.
steps.caption: The new place opens on the Hourly tab; the arrows show there are other places.
steps.expected: 부산 is added to your saved places.

steps.title: Switch between saved places
steps.instruction: Swipe left or right on the weather at the top of the page, or tap the arrows.
steps.caption: The previous place (명동) shows.
steps.expected: The tabs keep the place you switched to.

steps.title: Add a place abroad
steps.instruction: Search for London on 즐겨찾기 and tap the result.
steps.caption: London's weather from the international provider.
steps.expected: London is added after your other places.

steps.title: Edit the places list
steps.instruction: On 즐겨찾기 tap 편집 (Edit).
steps.caption: The current-location switch and a delete button (⊗) on every other place.
steps.expected: Changes apply at once.

steps.title: Delete a place
steps.instruction: Tap ⊗ next to London, then tap 확인 (Done).
steps.caption: London is gone from the list.
steps.expected: A deleted place's alarms are removed too.

steps.title: Set notifications for a place
steps.instruction: Open the place's weather and tap the bell at the top.
steps.caption: The weather alert (악천후 경보) with its hours, weekdays, and alarm times (날씨알람).
steps.expected: A new place starts with suggested settings.

steps.title: Set an alarm time
steps.instruction: Tap an alarm's gear (7:40). Use the arrows to choose a time, then 설정 (Set), 삭제 (Delete) or 닫기 (Close).
steps.caption: The 12-hour time picker in 5-minute steps.
steps.expected: Here 닫기 leaves the time unchanged. As in the Cordova app, setting 12:00 AM deletes the alarm.

steps.title: Leave without saving
steps.instruction: Tap the back arrow. Choose 닫기 (Close) to leave without saving, or 저장 (Save).
steps.caption: 저장하시겠습니까? appears because the suggested settings count as changes.
steps.expected: This manual leaves without saving, so no alarm is registered.

steps.title: Open the menu
steps.instruction: Tap the menu button (three lines) at the top left.
steps.caption: The menu: Korea-only pages, settings, privacy, feedback, review, version and information.
steps.expected: The back arrow closes the menu.

steps.title: Choose measurement units
steps.instruction: Tap 단위설정 (Units).
steps.caption: Temperature, wind, pressure, distance, precipitation and the air-quality standard.
steps.expected: Each row opens its choices.

steps.title: Choose a temperature unit
steps.instruction: Tap 온도단위 (Temperature), then F.
steps.caption: C and F; the check mark shows the choice.
steps.expected: The choice is saved at once.

steps.title: Check the saved unit
steps.instruction: Go back to the weather.
steps.caption: Temperatures in °F. This manual then sets °C again.
steps.expected: Every page and the alarms use the new unit.

steps.title: Choose the startup tab
steps.instruction: In the menu tap 시작 페이지 (Startup page).
steps.caption: 시간별날씨, 일별날씨, 즐겨찾기 or 대기정보.
steps.expected: The app opens on that tab next time.

steps.title: Choose the refresh interval
steps.instruction: In the menu tap 업데이트 주기 (Refresh interval).
steps.caption: 수동 (manual) or every 30 minutes to 12 hours.
steps.expected: The weather reloads at the chosen interval.

steps.title: Choose a theme
steps.instruction: In the menu tap 테마 설정 (Theme), then 어두운 테마 (Dark).
steps.caption: 날씨 사진 테마 (photo), 밝은 테마 (light), 어두운 테마 (dark) and 이전 테마 (old).
steps.expected: The theme applies at once.

steps.title: Read weather in the dark theme
steps.instruction: Go back to the weather.
steps.caption: The pages in dark colors.
steps.expected: This manual then tries the photo theme and returns to the light theme.

steps.title: Use the photo theme
steps.instruction: Choose 날씨 사진 테마.
steps.caption: The photo theme's outlined text over the photo's area. This build has no photo feed, so the area stays plain.
steps.expected: With the feed, a photo matching the weather shows.

steps.title: Read weather warnings
steps.instruction: In the menu tap 기상특보 (Weather warnings).
steps.caption: The current bulletins with their times. Read each announcement time.
steps.expected: The back arrow returns to the tabs.

steps.title: View nationwide weather
steps.instruction: In the menu tap 전국날씨 (Nationwide weather).
steps.caption: Cities on the map with sky and temperature.
steps.expected: The page loads with a spinner first.

steps.title: Change the nationwide map mode
steps.instruction: Tap 풍향/풍속 (Wind).
steps.caption: Wind direction and speed per city. 강수량 shows precipitation.
steps.expected: The map switches modes at once.

steps.title: View nationwide air quality
steps.instruction: In the menu tap 전국미세먼지 (Nationwide air).
steps.caption: Province values in their grade colors; tabs for PM2.5, PM10, O3, NO2, SO2 and CO.
steps.expected: Swipe the tabs sideways for the rest.

steps.title: Read app information
steps.instruction: In the menu tap 정보 (About).
steps.caption: The data sources and the notice that real-time data is unverified.
steps.expected: 확인 closes it.

steps.title: Choose optional usage statistics
steps.instruction: In the menu tap 선택적 이용 통계 (Optional usage statistics). Choose 거부 / 철회 (Decline) or 동의 (Agree).
steps.caption: Analytics is off until you agree; you can withdraw at any time.
steps.expected: This manual declines; the row shows 꺼짐 (Off).

steps.title: Review advertising privacy options
steps.instruction: In the menu tap 광고 개인정보 선택 (Ad privacy).
steps.caption: Google's privacy options form, or this message when none is required in your region.
steps.expected: Advertising privacy is separate from usage statistics.

steps.title: Share the weather
steps.instruction: On a weather page tap the share button at the top right.
steps.caption: iOS's share sheet with the place's weather text and the app link.
steps.expected: Choose an app, or close the sheet. No message was sent for this manual.
